d: Following the Republican Party’s defeat in the 2026 US midterm elections, President Donald Trump has acknowledged that the Iran war may have influenced voters, while insisting he would make the same decision again. Firstpost examines Trump’s options for ending the West Asia conflict, including renewed military action and diplomacy. The defeat has also exposed growing divisions within the Republican Party and the MAGA movement, with JD Vance blaming the Iran war, Donald Trump Jr. backing him, and figures including Ted Cruz, Mitt Romney and Ron DeSantis questioning the party’s direction.…
